title: PDF password remover: unlock a PDF
description: Remove a password you know from a PDF and lift restrictions on printing, copying and editing. The saved file opens without a password. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

kind.password: Password accepted. You can save a copy of the file that opens without a password.
kind.restricted: The file opens without a password but has restrictions, such as no printing or copying text. Save a copy without them.
kind.none: This file isn't protected: it has no password and no restrictions. There's nothing to remove.
